about: What print-shop's profiles cover (the Sponsor, 2026-10-25, on mqucifer/print-shop#8): the
0.4 mm nozzle machine, its 0.20 mm process, and PLA and PETG. 'standard' names Orca's own
system presets, imported whole as the base. Each of the Sponsor's tuned presets that
inherits one of them is imported as an overlay of only the keys it changes, unless it's
'left_out' here, with why. Adding a printer, nozzle or filament is a PR to this file.
Elegoo's carbon- and glass-filled PLA and PETG are not listed: they need a hardened nozzle.
